known_bias: every reviewed pair was proposed by the engine's own name-based candidate step, so the true HFR record is lexically reachable by construction; this favours TF-IDF. A null primary result is weak evidence against transfer; a harm result is strong evidence.

labels.note: includes 3 corrections made 2026-11-21 after a shared-source-id check

n_note: 86 queries: a 2-point gain is about 2 queries; the bootstrap interval will be wide.
question: Does an encoder fine-tuned on Wikidata names carry over to Nigerian health-facility records?

primary.arm: fine-tuned E0b amendment-1 wikidata_ng models, mean of seeds 0-2
primary.gallery: every HFR facility name in the same state (data/hfr_<state>.csv)
primary.metric: recall@10 of the reviewed HFR record
primary.no_harm: paired bootstrap 95% lower bound of the gain > -2 points
primary.transfer_shown: mean gain >= 2 points AND paired pair-bootstrap (10,000) 95% lower bound > 0

secondary: the same for the wikidata_wa models and zero-shot multilingual-e5-small

discrimination: AUC of cosine(GRID3 name, HFR name) for same_entity vs different over all 180 reviewed pairs, per arm, against tfidf cosine and the engine score; paired bootstrap of the AUC difference. Descriptive, not part of the verdict.
